snippet.title: KuduTek
snippet.description:
Excel SQL: Free videos to learn how to do database editing with Excel. Data Intelligence through Microsoft Excel - free advice, resources, tips and tricks.

Hi, my name is Jon Muller, founder of the company KuduTek.

​I am excited and committed to sharing with you what I know about Excel and data. I will be teaching you all the bits of knowledge-gems that I have accumulated through my 20 years of consulting work. My goal will be to follow a weekly release schedule.

​We will focus on using Excel as a practical solution and striking a balance between using SQL and Excel together. I will show you how to use real-time data connectivity with SQL for the heavy-lifting data crunching work and Excel as the presentation platform and for higher level light-weight data validation and processing.

​Most Excel gurus focus on read-only data pulling. However, I will teach you practical ways to not only pull data but also update and add data into the database. Learn more at kudutek.com

snippet.title: Ken Fornari
snippet.description:
Hi 👋 I’m Ken. I help ordinary people sell high-quality books on Amazon KDP and Audible — without prior experience, a big budget, or months of guessing.

I started publishing a few years ago with 0 sales, 0 reviews, and $0 in royalties. After hundreds of hours of research and putting in the reps, I've gone from $143 in my first month to selling over 40,000 books and audiobooks, generating $230,000+ in royalties, and I still earn every single month from Amazon and Audible without fail.

This channel is where I organize my thinking around self-publishing and give a guidepost for anyone who wants to build a real, sustainable income from books on Amazon.

To that end, you’ll find data-driven topic research, book creation and launch strategy, cover and listing breakdowns, AI-assisted publishing workflows, Amazon Ads walkthroughs, and anything else I find useful for building a profitable publishing business.

If you're new here, check out my most recent video :)

snippet.title: Mike Eastwood
snippet.description:
Fui DevOps Engineer durante 7 años y estaba perdiendo la motivación, hasta que llegó la IA. Al ver el poder de los LLM empecé a construir cosas: primero pequeñas y luego apps que resolvieran mis propios problemas.

MIS APPS EN LA APP STORE (gratis, enlaces abajo)
1. Tobydoro, la primera: temporizador de foco con el método Flowmodoro.
2. Hazlo: seguimiento de hábitos.
3. Countie: cuentas atrás con widgets. Soy malo para recordar cosas y la construí en 3 horas, en un tren de Austria a Ámsterdam.
4. tregua: cambia la cuadrícula de iconos por un lanzador de texto tranquilo.
En construcción: StudyBuddy y Teleprompter.

MI STACK
• Claude Code y Codex: escriben el código conmigo.
• Grok Bot: publica en X los posts que apruebo.
• firstmate: coordina a los demás agentes.
• herdr: organiza en la terminal las sesiones de los agentes.
• WezTerm: mi terminal.

Web: https://mikeastwood.dev
Contacto: mike@mikeastwood.dev

snippet.title: 入江慎吾 / AIと個人開発

snippet.title: Zerodha
snippet.description:
Welcome to the official YouTube channel of Zerodha. Here you'll find product updates, tutorials, company announcements, and conversations with the people who work here.

Zerodha started in 2010 with a simple idea: broking in India was too expensive and complicated. We introduced flat-fee pricing and built our own trading platforms, helping make discount broking the norm across the industry.

Today, we're one of India's largest brokerages, with over 1.8 crore customers. We've built Kite for trading and investing, Console for reporting, Coin for direct mutual funds, and Varsity for learning about the markets.

Through Rainmatter, we back startups in fintech, health, climate, and deep tech, while Rainmatter Foundation supports work on climate and the environment.

We've never advertised or had a sales team. Most of our growth has come through word of mouth, which is also how this channel works.

Zerodha Broking Limited | SEBI Registration No.: INZ000031633

snippet.title: 禁断政論ニュース
snippet.description:
**【政治断罪】副業しなければ、もう普通の生活すら守れない日本へ。**

真面目に働いている。それなのに生活が苦しい。

物価は上がり、税金や社会保険料の負担は重く、給料が増えても暮らしに余裕が生まれない。

かつては本業の収入だけで家族を養い、家を持ち、将来のために貯金する。そんな当たり前の生活を目指せたはずです。

しかし今、「副業しなければ生活できない」「老後のために自分で稼ぐしかない」と考える人が増えています。

なぜ、普通に働くだけでは安心して暮らせないのか。

政治は国民の生活を本当に見ているのか。

このチャンネルでは、税金、社会保険料、物価高、賃金、そして政府の経済政策を取り上げ、私たちの暮らしに何が起きているのかを検証していきます。

政治への批判だけで終わらせず、副業や個人で収入を生み出す方法についても発信していきます。

**政治が変わるのを待つだけでは、自分や家族の生活を守れないかもしれない。**

だからこそ、政治を知り、自分でも稼ぐ力を身につける。

あなたは今の日本で、本業の収入だけで安心して暮らせていますか？

ぜひコメント欄で意見を聞かせてください。

チャンネル登録・高評価もよろしくお願いします。

snippet.title: Andrey Zenin
snippet.description:
За 12 лет я понял одну вещь: многие умеют круто работать, но почти никто не умеет строить из своего дела актив, который стоит дорого. Моя миссия — это исправить.

Мой опыт:
- 400+ сделок по продаже бизнесов (от 1 до 30 млн ₽)
- Сделка на $5m по продаже компании с комиссией 15м ₽
- 3 созданные и проданные онлайн-школы (по 30 млн ₽ каждая).
- 2000+ продаж моих продуктов (от 100к каждая) через автоматические системы (без моего участия)

О чем канал: помочь превратить ваше дело в капитал. От идеи и первых заказов выстроить систему, которая приносит большие чеки и стоит дорого на рынке

Здесь я делюсь тем, как:
1. Перестать продавать свое время дешево и начать продавать ценность.
2. Настроить поток клиентов, чтобы бизнес стал предсказуемым
3. Продавать на высокие чеки через искреннюю заботу об интересах клиента
4. Создать бизнес, который можно не только развивать, но и выгодно продать

Подпишитесь, если вы хотите строить свое дело с душой и создавать то, что будет иметь ценность годами

snippet.title: Sketch The Stack
snippet.description:
Hand-drawn explainers.

Four things get covered here:

SOFTWARE; system design and the things that break in production, always opened with a moment you have actually had rather than a diagram.

CONCEPTS; one idea at a time from physics, chemistry and finance.

AI RESEARCH AND TOOLS; a new arXiv paper or a trending GitHub repo, read properly. What it found, what it did not, and which licence it carries.

LAUNCHES; a new product, what problem it solves, and what it costs.

The rule every video follows: it ends by saying what it is NOT claiming. If nobody here ran the thing, the video says so; if a paper measured one narrow case, the video says that too. Sources are linked in every description so you can check the claim rather than take it.

Subtitles on everything.

Also on Instagram and X as @sketchthestack.

For work enquiries, the business email on this page reaches me.

snippet.title: Investors way
snippet.description:
Investing made me curious as soon as I got to know about it, and it's a well-known fact that to build a better tomorrow, you need to invest a part of what you earn, whether it is in stocks, mutual funds, real estate, bonds, gold, etc.

At first, I used to wonder why there was so little exposure to people investing in these assets. Later, I realized that there are plenty of people who understand the importance of it, but the problem is that when they are involved in their daily jobs, most of them don't have enough time to understand the basics, and they don't understand where to start. For the majority of those people, investing seems pretty complex.

So here I am to make investing and finance easy for you.

snippet.title: Sachdeva AI
snippet.description:
Namaste 🙏, I am Guarav Sachdeva.

When I was in school, I watched *Iron Man* for the first time — and like many others, I was fascinated by JARVIS. The idea of having an intelligent assistant that could solve problems, answer questions, and actually help in daily life blew my mind.

From that moment on, I knew I wanted to build something like that — something smart, helpful, and human-friendly. But there was one problem: I wasn’t from a tech background.

That didn’t stop me. I dove deep into the world of AI, learning everything I could. And now, with AI booming, I see a bigger opportunity — not just to build tools, but to **help others like me understand and use AI without needing a technical background**.

My mission is simple: **Make AI so easy and friendly that anyone — tech or non-tech — can use it to solve real problems and improve their life.**

If JARVIS inspired me, I want to build tools that inspire and empower *you*.

For Business inquiries - sachdevaaiofficial@gmail.com

snippet.title: Baptiste ODonovan
snippet.description:
Hi there, I'm Baptiste. I've helped dozens of businesses across the world with AI implementation, from automations to complex agentic workflows. 

I have a decade of experience working at some of the largest media agencies in the world and was fortunate to work with great clients, including Shell, Ferrari, Binance, Adidas, and many more. 

My expertise in AI comes from running my own agency and solving my problems first, which led me to go all-in on AI in '24, before Claude was even a thing.

This channel is my way of giving back and showing how you can use and apply AI to make a real difference in your business, whether you're a solopreneur or a 1,000-person business. No fluff, no over-hyped takes. Just value you can use today.

If you have any questions, feel free to ask, and I'll happily respond in the comments! Thanks for reading.

snippet.title: Chris IA
snippet.description:
Vous avez une idée d'application mais vous ne savez pas coder ? Bienvenue dans l'ère du VibeCoding.

Ici, on ne parle pas de syntaxe complexe ou de lignes de code interminables. On parle d'intention, de créativité et de vitesse. Je vous apprends à utiliser l'IA (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude, GPT-4) pour transformer vos concepts en produits réels, en quelques minutes au lieu de quelques mois.

snippet.title: Brandon Timothy
snippet.description:

Growing up, art and entrepreneurship have always been a passion of mine.

After high school, I became an Electrician out of practicality and continued for six years. Although I was succeeding in my professional career, there was a void that needed to be filled. I started e-commerce stores and continuously challenged myself with new opportunities.

In 2016, I finally took a leap of faith and quit my 9-5 job to pursue my passion. Since then, I've been able to support myself by doing what I love & I'm truly grateful for that.

My goal now is to share with you what I've learned, along with mistakes I've made. I hope to help inspire you to turn your passion into a real career. 

I know this is possible because it happened to me & I really believe anyone can do it with the right guidance.

Subscribe if you want to learn more.

All the best,
Brandon

snippet.title: Slushy Trade
snippet.description:
Most people are never taught how trading or markets actually work.

They’re told to “just hold” or end up following fake influencers, gambling behavior, and toxic trading communities.

That’s why we built Slushy.

Created by Dark Forest — four longtime friends involved in crypto since 2012 — Slushy is a competitive paper trading ecosystem designed to help people learn before risking real capital.

Practice setups, analyze charts, track mistakes, improve risk management, and use AI-assisted tools to better understand why trades succeed or fail.

No fake gurus.
No blind signals.
No “get rich quick” nonsense.

Just real learning, discipline, competition, and growth.

Users compete globally on paper trading accounts, with weekly rewards distributed back into the community.

Our mission is simple:

Learn first.
Risk later.
Build discipline.
Grow together.

Welcome to the forest.

#crypto #trading #papertrading #investing #bitcoin #web3

snippet.title: The GrowthStack
snippet.description:
The Growth Stack is a podcast that breaks down why smart teams make dumb growth decisions.

We go beyond tactics, tools, and surface-level advice to understand how growth actually works in practice, across AI, marketing, product, and strategy.

Each episode focuses on:

how real growth strategies are built
where they start to break

snippet.title: Analytics Vidhya
snippet.description:
For those of you, who are wondering what is “Analytics Vidhya”, “Analytics” can be defined as the science of extracting insights from raw data. 

The spectrum of analytics starts from capturing data and evolves into using insights/trends from this data to make informed decisions. 

“Vidhya” on the other hand is a Sanskrit noun meaning “Knowledge” or “Clarity on a subject”. Knowledge, which has been gained through reading literature or through self-practice / experimentation.

Analytics Vidhya provides a community-based knowledge portal for Analytics and Data Science professionals. The aim of the platform is to become a complete portal serving all knowledge and career needs of Data Science Professionals.

If you want to learn how to build a high-income AI skillset, sell valuable AI solutions, and become an AI Integrator, you’re in the right place.

snippet.title: Decentralizer
snippet.description:

My approach: show the data, separate fact from speculation, and give you the counterargument too. Institutional analysis, not influencer hype.

株式会社ヒルトル 代表取締役
デジタルマーケッター/コンテンツクリエイター
1985年生まれ 東京都出身

大学卒業後、就職せずに欧州に逃亡するも挫折し、日本に帰国。コンサル会社勤務を経て、2012年より独立。中小企業経営者、個人事業主を対象に、WEBマーケティングのノウハウを伝え、集客と売上を安定させるための助言を提供するオンライン集客コンサルタント。「世界には素晴らしい考え方やツールがあるのに、言葉の壁や情報格差のせいで、多くの人が素晴らしいチャンスの存在を知らず、ゴールに到達することができていない」という現状を打破すべく、世界中を股にかけ、精力的に活動中。

Three layers: licensed data drawn from a wide range of market sources; standardized deterministic analyses computed from it by a fleet of specialized scientists across technical, fundamental, news, sentiment, on-chain, alternative-data, and discovery research; and AI inference that turns those results into structured findings with supporting metrics, confidence, and stated limitations, plus a plain-language summary from SAGE.

AstraEye does not route orders and does not transact on anyone's behalf. Every decision stays with the person reading the research.

This channel publishes training and product content for informational and educational purposes only. Nothing here is investment advice.

Available in the United States, to adults 18 and over.

snippet.title: Bismarck Ebiweh Business
snippet.description:
I'll help you get more clients from your content without ever needing to go viral.

I used to go viral constantly. Millions of views a video. Followers pouring in. And when my team got on sales calls with the people those views brought in, they were broke. Every single call.

So I stopped chasing views. Figured out how to make content for the one person who can actually pay, and my business didn't hit seven figures until I did.

Now I run a company that builds content engines for business owners, so the people who book calls show up already sold.

The topics I'll cover are:

Why your content gets views but no clients (and how to fix it)
How to pre-sell buyers before they ever get on a call with you
Content that attracts people who can actually afford you
How to fill your calendar without posting every day or chasing trends

If you're a business owner doing six figures and your content isn't bringing you clients, my team builds the entire engine for you.

You can book a call below.

snippet.title: Wharton AI & Analytics Initiative

For more information, visit www.ai-analytics.wharton.upenn.edu.

snippet.title: Kirsten Biema | KI — aber richtig
snippet.description:
Ich bin Kirsten — Jahrgang 1972, Analog Native und Business-Mentorin mit über 25 Jahren Erfahrung darin, Unternehmen durch technologische Umbrüche zu führen.

Ich habe die Digitalisierung nicht aus dem Lehrbuch gelernt. Ich habe sie erlebt — von den ersten Computern im Büro bis zur KI-Revolution heute. Und genau das ist mein Vorteil: Ich weiß, wie sich Wandel anfühlt, was er von Menschen fordert — und wie man ihn für sein Business nutzt, statt von ihm überrollt zu werden.

Auf diesem Kanal zeige ich Solopreneuren, Coaches und kleinen Unternehmen im DACH-Raum, wie KI wirklich im Alltag funktioniert — ohne Hype, ohne Überforderung, mit echten Ergebnissen.

Andere erklären KI aus dem Lehrbuch. Ich aus 25 Jahren Praxis.

snippet.title: Alexander Petkov
snippet.description:
This channel is for closers, founders, and operators who want to master sales, scale with AI, and build a business they own.

I’ve closed over $1.3M in sales across multiple industries.

How I got here...

Started in door-to-door sales at 19, selling construction systems to real estate investors, engineers, and contractors.
Spent 3 years eating rejection with almost no wins.

Then joined a Wolf of Wall Street-style trading company.
100+ reps. 300-500 cold calls daily.
Hit 1,219 calls in one day.
By month two, I had zero deals and was nearly fired.
The pressure flipped everything - I hit quota and my first $10K+ months.

Then 2 years in B2B SaaS - built outbound from scratch, trained the team, and became the top 2 performer out of 20+ reps.

In May 2025, I quit to go all-in on:
🔧 Cost Effective Software - Custom Software Agency with AI first personalised software build for small and medium business owners.

Now I share the exact systems and lessons that got me here while helping others

snippet.title: Typesense
snippet.description:
Typesense is the fastest way to add typo-tolerant, instant search to your app — without needing a PhD in search infrastructure.

Typesense is an open-source alternative to hosted search platforms. Easily build blazing-fast, full-text search experiences with typo tolerance, faceting, filtering, and geo search — all through a clean, developer-friendly API.

Whether you’re building a documentation site, product search, or AI-powered assistant, our tutorials and tips help you ship faster. From indexing large datasets to customizing ranking and relevance, we cover everything you need to make search just work.

Typesense gives you fine-grained control over your search experience while keeping the setup simple. Self-host with Docker, deploy on your stack, or use Typesense Cloud for zero-maintenance scaling.

Get started with just a few lines of code — no complex query DSLs, no vendor lock-in.
Build in minutes, scale effortlessly.

I started coding at 10 bc my dad's a software engineer and taught me to build traffic lights for my Legos. Got obsessed. Then I moved to web stuff and spent a few years doing Fiverr gigs for €20, which is honestly where my love for coding died.

The day I turned 18 I started my first company with a friend. Never got real traction but I loved building again. Joined a medical AI startup as CTO after that, shipped real product, then slowly lost the meaning. So I quit.

snippet.title: Matt Strauss
snippet.description:
AI Doesn't Have to be Exhausting! I think this is something everyone needs to hear in this day and age. We're all feeling the effects of trying to do stuff all the time, trying to optimize every inch of our lives, and trying not to fall behind. 

But that sounds like a perfect way to burn out in my opinion. And it doesn't have to be! AI (in some form) is here to stay and my goal is to help you figure out how to use AI sustainably, and in a way that actually improves your work.

snippet.title: Julie Kaiser
snippet.description:
You're drowning in work. Other people are using AI to do their work faster and easier, but you don't have time or know where to start.

I hear you. I'm Julie Kaiser, a freelance science writer, and I've used AI in my work for three years. But getting to where it really helps took time. I've sunk over 400 hours into Claude Code in three months, applying it to client work, hobby projects, private things.

You don't have 400 hours, so I'm building this channel and my blog, where I cut what I learned into pieces you can apply to your work.

I built myself a full-fledged AI operating system: my projects, ideas and working rules as plain files that Claude Code can access and act on for me. I can't afford to be wrong in my client work, so everything you see here has survived my checking.

This isn't "download my whole system and figure out what to do with it." It's start small, reduce friction here and there, and find out what makes sense for you.

僕自身が実際に使い、どう仕事に組み込むか、どう自分専用に育てるかまで試します。うまくいった仕組みや手順、プロンプトだけでなく、失敗したことや向いていなかった使い方も共有していきます。

・生産性を高めるアプリ、Apple製品、ガジェット、仕事環境

Leo Tohyama / AIコーチ

元LINEヤフー株式会社 プロダクトマネージャー・企画組織マネージャー。現在は独立し、AI活用研修、YouTube運営支援、コンテンツ制作をしています。

YouTubeのPR設定や概要欄のPR表記はしませんが、初登場の際には必ず口頭で商品提供があった旨伝えます。なおこの場合、商品提供者（メーカー）がレビュー内容に干渉することはありません。

snippet.title: Luigi Fiano - Digital Growth Academy
snippet.description:
They replaced me with AI. No warning. Seven years at that company, a team of twenty under me, a salary I was proud of. Then one morning a piece of software was doing my job, and I wasn't needed anymore.

I could've spent months being angry about it. Instead I got curious. If AI was good enough to replace a manager, what could it do if it worked for me?

Turns out, a lot. I built a six-figure business in Europe from my kitchen table, working a few hours a month.
Now I want to see if I can do it again somewhere I have zero advantage. So I'm starting over in the US. No followers, no shortcuts, nothing hidden. Just me trying to get this thing to $100K a month, and filming the whole thing as it happens.
If you've ever felt the ground move under your career, you'll probably get why I'm doing this. Stick around and figure it out with me.

New videos every week.

Luigi

snippet.title: Luis Wester · Claude, AI & Archaeology
snippet.description:
I build AI systems so I can be human again.

Customer service, SEO, outreach, ecommerce operations. Not demos: systems running inside a business doing several million a year, where being wrong costs money rather than engagement. A support agent that closes most of our tickets untouched, at a fraction of what a human ticket cost. An SEO agent that rewrites our storefront overnight.

Claude Code and GPT write most of the code. What is left is deciding what to point them at, then finding where they were confidently wrong. That is usually the most useful part of the video. Agents, automation, and the unglamorous plumbing that makes them hold up in production.

The hours it hands back go into the other channel: an AI that reads 250 year old maps and LiDAR to hunt lost archaeological sites, and then me standing in a forest looking for them. Also a sacred cranium, allegedly.

Celtic gladiator and time traveller in my spare time.

Subscribe if you would rather see the wiring than the demo.

snippet.title: Yashica Jain
snippet.description:
Hi 👋 I’m Yashica, founder of Automatez AI. I build with AI, consult on AI, and teach people how to turn it into something useful.

I fell for AI the week ChatGPT went public. Everyone around me called it a toy.

Betting my career on it was terrifying. 

I did it anyway because something in me would not let go.

Best decision I’ve ever made. I’ll be doing this for the rest of my life.

Some people feel that way about painting, or music. I feel it about this. I get an artist's feeling every time I sit down to record, and I respect it.

I'm grateful the thing I love became the thing I do. I talk to AI more than I talk to humans now, and I'm only half joking.

I’m on it all day. I learn it, help businesses implement it, then bring the whole build here: the setup, prompts, and what broke along the way.

Over 1 million people have watched these builds.

New videos every week!

snippet.title: KGP Talkie

Join more than 200,000 learners and learn how to turn AI concepts into reliable products that people can actually use.

snippet.title: CompumasterHaiti
snippet.description:
Compumasterhaiti est une école d'informatique fondé en l'année 2005. pour ses anciens élèves, son adresse était à l'angle de la rue Saint-Honoré et Réunion. Suite aux dégâts matériels qu'a enregistrés l'institution lors du séisme du 12 janvier 2010, l'école a fermé ses portes. Entre-temps, quelques cours se sont dispensés aux locaux du carrefour Péan (FEEDSO). Pour répondre à la demande de la clientèle, le COMPUMASTERHAITI a repris les cours en 2016. 

Les cours dispensés peuvent varier à different niveau de compréhension et sont adaptés aux besoins de l'apprenant. Du débutant aux plus avancés, le compumasterhaiti utilise une technique de compréhension rapide basée sur la logique initiale de programmation, c'est comme tenir le boeuf par la queue. Vous apprenez facilement comment fonctionne la logique des ordinateurs, les systèmes d'opération, les programmes d'application, les fichiers etc. 

C'est une formation appliquée et orientée vers la logique de compréhension

snippet.title: Anik Singal
snippet.description:
In May 2022, everything changed.

I was about to sell my 9-figure company. Retire. Focus on my kids.
Then the FTC showed up.

18 months. $15M gone.
A brutal lawsuit that almost ended everything.

But I didn’t quit.

I fought back—and built something better!
 
A first-of-its-kind AI-powered software that helps marketing and sales teams automatically audit and monitor their advertising for compliance.

And guess what? It’s working.

Because of the FTC, I stumbled onto something incredible—a solution that could protect thousands of businesses from the same challenges I faced.

📈 What I Do Now

Today, through my new holding company Ugentic AI, I invest in and partner with AI & Martech SaaS companies, using the same growth strategies that helped scale my past businesses.

💰 If you own an innovative AI or Martech SaaS company with a fully built-out product and are looking for an investor who can help you scale faster—let’s talk.

snippet.title: Patrick Otis | Land Buyer
snippet.description:
They're not making any more of it. I'm Patrick Otis. I've bought over 550 acres of land, off market, across 10 states, and I now buy around Cincinnati, in Ohio, Kentucky, and Indiana. Some I keep, some I farm, and some I split into homesteads for families who want a few acres of their own.

I believe land is the foundation of wealth, and we live in a country that lets a regular person own some. My goal is to help my family and a few others own a little piece of America before it all ends up with overseas corporations or Wall Street.

On this channel:
→ How to buy your first acre. Finding it, pricing it, checking access, water, septic, and boundaries, and making the offer.
→ Real properties, walked and bought. What I look for, what I pay, what I do with it.
→ Building out a 70-acre farm in Clermont County into homesteads, start to finish.

Nine years in real estate, full-time in land since 2020, 100+ deals. One-person operation. Broken parts included.

snippet.title: Ömer Göçmen | Yapay Zeka & Otomasyon
snippet.description:
Yazılım geliştirme, yapay zeka araçları ve güncel teknoloji trendleri üzerine anlaşılır, pratik ve uygulamalı içerikler paylaşıyorum.

Bu kanalda ChatGPT nasıl kullanılır, GPT modelleriyle neler yapılabilir, Claude nasıl kullanılır, Claude Opus, Sonnet ve diğer AI modelleri arasındaki farklar nelerdir gibi konuları bulabilirsiniz.

Ayrıca Cursor, Cline, Codex ve benzeri yapay zeka destekli kodlama araçlarıyla nasıl daha hızlı yazılım geliştirileceğini; AI ile kod yazma, proje geliştirme, otomasyon kurma ve içerik üretme süreçlerini örneklerle anlatıyorum.

Temel kodlama eğitimleri, yapay zeka projeleri, makine öğrenimi örnekleri, yazılım geliştirme ipuçları, AI model karşılaştırmaları ve güncel teknoloji haberleriyle hem yeni başlayanlara hem de geliştiricilere katkı sağlamayı hedefliyorum.

Yapay zeka, kodlama, AI araçları, teknoloji trendleri ve yazılım dünyasını yakından takip etmek istiyorsanız kanala abone olabilirsiniz.

snippet.title: Jose's Vintage Keys
snippet.description:
I’ve been immersed in vintage keyboards and synthesizers for over four decades.
Over the years, passion, patience and a bit of luck led to a collection of instruments I deeply care about, including the CS-80, OB-X, Minimoog, Super JX-10, VP-330, Yamaha CP-70, Rhodes, Wurlitzer and Solina.

This channel isn’t about collecting gear. It’s about playing.
Alongside reinterpreting music by artists who shaped electronic music, such as Vangelis, Jean-Michel Jarre and Tangerine Dream, I regularly perform live improvisations, letting the instruments lead and capturing the moment as it unfolds.

These sessions focus on expression, dynamics and interaction, rather than polish or perfection.

Alongside that, I’m constantly working on my own music.
Still learning. Still exploring. Guided by curiosity rather than perfection.

Contact: jeevers1964@gmail.com

हमारा उद्देश्य आपको रोजमर्रा की ज़िंदगी से जुड़ी समस्याओं के सरल और उपयोगी समाधान प्रदान करना है। 

हमारे यूट्यूब चैनल पर आपको टेक्नोलॉजी, ऑनलाइन Earning, फ्रीलांसिंग, डिजिटल मार्केटिंग, ट्रेडिंग न्यूज़, technology news अपडेट्स, और घर बैठे पैसे कमाने के बेहतरीन तरीकों की जानकारी मिलती है।

हमारे यूट्यूब चैनल की शुरुआत 23 मार्च 2024 को की गई थी, जिसका मुख्य उद्देश्य आम लोगों की डिजिटल दुनिया से जुड़ी परेशानियों को दूर करना और उन्हें सही दिशा में मार्गदर्शन देना है।

यदि आपको किसी भी प्रकार की समस्या आती है, तो आप हमसे बेझिझक संपर्क कर सकते हैं। हम आपकी सहायता के लिए हमेशा तत्पर हैं।

snippet.title: AI業務ハックチャンネル
snippet.description:
本チャンネルでは

- 実務に即した「本当に使える」生成AIの活用例
- 3年後も廃れない、一生使えるAIの基礎知識

を発信していきます。

## 中の人のプロフィール
本名：大橋 啓介
早稲田大学情報理工学部卒業、新卒でIndeed Japan株式会社にソフトウェアエンジニアとして入社。米国向けの人材/企業の推薦システムの開発に従事。2024年に独立。Indeedにてユーザー数1億人以上のプラットフォーム、AIシステムの開発に携わった経験をもとに、専門性とわかりやすさを両立した、信頼できるAIの情報発信を心がけています。

## 思想、想い、チャンネル設立の背景
ChatGPTが2022年に登場し、今後10年の世界のトレンドが決まってしまいました。世界のトレンドとはすなわち、AI、そしてその後にくるロボットです。

今後の人生において、AIがなくなることは一生ありません。そんな世の中において、個人・企業の生存戦略として、生成AIをどう応用していくかは最重要テーマと言っても過言ではないはずです。

僕は普段ソフトウェアエンジニアとしてシステム開発に携わっているのですが、生成AIによって、仕事の仕方が根本的に変わりました。ソフトウェア開発の領域で現在起こっている変化が、今後幅広い業界・職種において起こっていくはずです。

そんな激動の世の中において、AIに対しての専門性、わかりやすさ、役立ち度を兼ね備えたメディアを作り、世の中を啓蒙したいという想いから、このチャンネルを立ち上げました。

以下のようなコンセプトに基づいて発信しています
- 「それって本当に試してんの？」みたいな事例は発信しない
- 「それって本当に役立つの？」みたいな事例は発信しない
- 1ヶ月には使えなくなるような、すぐ廃れる内容は発信しない
- 1年後、3年後も使えるような、普遍的な生成AIの理解、応用
- デモは何よりも雄弁、とにかく実際に動いている姿を見せる

- The Weekly Check: 5-7 AI news items of the week, each rated useful / wait / hype. Fridays.

HOW WE WORK
- Primary sources first. Every video links them in the description.
- Original diagrams built from code, no stock footage.
- Limits and costs in every video.
- No hype, no clickbait.

snippet.title: Ilya Khodorkovskiy | Molecules and Money
snippet.description:
What makes a treatment worth developing, and what makes the company behind it worth backing? Those questions are closely connected, but each needs its own evidence.

Molecules & Money explores biotech and health science from both sides. I’m Ilya Khodorkovskiy, trained in pharmacology and finance, and I look at how treatments work, what their studies show and where they fit alongside competing approaches.

Some videos focus on the biology or a clinical study. Others examine a company or test a specific health claim, with attention to the assumptions that could change as more evidence arrives.

You don’t need specialist knowledge. I explain the technical terms and include sources so you can follow and check the reasoning.

New videos three times a week. Subscribe to follow along.

Everything here is my opinion and is for education and discussion only. It is not medical, financial, or investment advice.

→ bioequityinsights.com

snippet.description:
I come from where most people feel stuck.

I didn’t have elite college tags or easy shortcuts. But I still cracked an internship at Goldman Sachs, a full-time role at a big MNC, and gigs with U.S.-based startups by figuring it all out, one painful step at a time.

I’m not here to teach. I’m not here to sell you a dream.

I’m here because I was like you. Confused, overwhelmed, and searching for direction when nothing made sense.

Today, I think like a builder. I move like a leader. But it didn’t start that way.

snippet.title: simon42
snippet.description:
Hey, ich bin Simon 👋

ITler, den Technik begeistert, wenn sie den Alltag wirklich einfacher macht! Angefangen hat alles 2015 mit einem Raspberry Pi. Lief so mittel: Sprachansagen um 2 Uhr nachts & meine Frau musste im Dunkeln duschen, weil die Automation spinnt 😅

Wenn ich damals Hilfe suchte, gab es zwei Sorten Videos: 40 Minuten Geschwafel für 5 Minuten Inhalt - oder so oberflächlich, dass ich danach genauso schlau war wie vorher.

Irgendwann dachte ich: Das geht besser! Smart Home soll jedem helfen - nicht nur Leuten, die freiwillig YAML schreiben. Und es soll Arbeit abnehmen, nicht zum Zweitjob werden.
Darum gibt es seit 2022 diesen Kanal: Home Assistant, Smart Home & KI auf den Punkt. Mit Lösungen, die bei mir zuhause laufen.

Das hat mich so gepackt, dass ich 2025 meinen Job gekündigt habe. 2026 kam unser erstes Kind - Zeit ist seitdem heilig.

Deshalb geht's hier um eine Frage: Wie du 🫵 dir mit smarter Technik Lebenszeit zurückholst.



📩 Kooperationen: simon42@espmedia.de

But I didn’t quit.

hurricanes, catastrophic losses, and every challenge this industry throws at you.

owners, industry veterans, and people doing the real work in insurance claims.

creation, and exit planning for business owners in the trades and home services 
space. If that is you, come find me there: www.youtube.com/@AllBusinessVince

New episodes monthly. Subscribe and stay in the loop.

snippet.title: ParseAI
snippet.description:
AI systems and software engineering, explained without the hype. 

I build production systems with and without AI every day and teach what I learn. Not the beginner stuff. If you want to know how these things actually work, and why they break, this is for you. 

WHAT'S HERE FOR YOU ?

- Agent internals: the loop, the harness, context, tools, MCP
- Retrieval that ships:  RAG, chunking, reranking, drift 
- System design: agentic and distributed, what interviews ask
- Failure autopsies: what broke, and the guard that stops it 
- The words everyone nods at  idempotent, back-pressure, grounding 
- Ship discipline: migrations, rollouts, repos an agent can't break 

Vendor-neutral by design, as i believe the tools change, the mechanisms don't. 

Examples come from whatever I'm building myself or with Claude Code, model APIs, open weights,  but the point is the pattern, not the product. 

Every video leaves you one thing you can change tomorrow.

New every day, under a minute each.

snippet.title: Adhiraj Singh
snippet.description:
I'm Adhiraj Singh, from India who builds AI products and ships them. This channel is where I build in public.

ClaudeRabbit is an open-source security scanner for GitHub repositories. Most scanners only read code. This one runs it, inside a disposable hardware-isolated sandbox, and catches malware in the act. Live at clauderabbit.in.

Pockit saves anything from anywhere on your phone in one tap, and finds it again. Built with Flutter and Supabase.

SecondBrain is a personal operating system built on the Model Context Protocol. It is the Notion of the AI era, agentic and local.

Treye is next.

I work across the whole stack: agentic AI, MCP, multi-agent systems, prompt engineering, Python, React, Next.js, Flutter, and the infrastructure underneath. I've also run real ad campaigns and built for clients, so I think about unit economics as hard as I think about code.

Expect build logs, product demos, and breakdowns of AI, startups, and the business behind the code.

Partially or fully automated trading programs can only be used to support the trader. Past performance is not an indication of future results.

snippet.title: Aryan Sharma
snippet.description:
I build the AI systems companies actually run on and I break down exactly how they work.

Companies lose money in the same places: risk spotted too late, revenue leaking where nobody is looking, judgment calls made on gut instead of evidence.

I've built and deployed 7 production systems against those problems:

— Client churn caught months before renewal, not at it
— Supply chain disruption traced through the bill of materials to the customer orders actually at risk
— Hiring screened at volume, low-confidence calls routed to a human instead of guessed
— Retention scored per customer across the lifecycle, not against a fixed threshold
— Prospect research run as a pipeline, not a headcount problem
— Inbound qualified and answered in seconds, day or night

Every video takes one system apart: the decision that made it work, the failure that nearly killed it, the fix that shipped. No theory. No demos that collapse in production.

New breakdown every week.

snippet.title: Christian Peverelli
snippet.description:
Hi 👋 I'm Christian. I've been building startups for 15 years. A decade in I started teaching it, and I've since trained 600+ non-technical founders across 24 countries.

Along the way I co-directed the LA chapter of a global pre-accelerator whose alumni have raised $50M+ and gone on to Techstars, YC, and 500 Startups, built two companies, and watched AI make the hardest part of a startup (building it) almost free.

Which created a new problem. AI solved building. It didn't solve knowing what to build, who pays for it, and how not to burn six months on an app nobody wants. That gap is what this channel is about.

You'll find build-alongs with Lovable and Claude, teardowns of half-finished products, how to get your first paying customer before the product is done, and interviews with founders who did it.

If you have a half-built app and no customers, you're in the right place. Ask me anything in the comments. Thanks for reading.

Contact us - info@wearenocode.com

snippet.description: Hey!  My name is Cassie Kicak.  I quit my 9-5 in 2021 to pursue a marketing business and I want to share the journey with you! snippet.title: In The Money by Zerodha
snippet.description:
In The Money is an education initiative by Zerodha, built to explore trading and active investing with nuance, data, and depth.

Much of what passes for trading education is misleading noise—glorifying profits, hiding risks, and selling tips, courses, or subscriptions.

We're a brokerage, so yes, we make money when you trade. But we don't nudge you to trade unnecessarily. Nor do we dismiss trading altogether.

Our goal is simple: honest, unfiltered perspectives on ideas rarely discussed elsewhere.

We dig into data across asset classes—equities, futures, options, commodities—to understand what works, what doesn't, and why. We share weekly market updates, data-driven insights, and in-depth market stories, while debunking misleading ideas. We also speak to top minds in trading about how they approach the markets.

Fair warning: making money through trading is extremely difficult, and most people lose money. We'd rather you knew that before learning it the expensive way.

snippet.title: Science Based AI
snippet.description:
"When art critics get together they talk about form and structure and meaning. When artists get together they talk about where you can buy cheap turpentine" - Picasso. 

Right now, the same thing is happening in the world of AI. The AI narrative is owned by engineers and hype peddlers. As much as I love the engineers, they often don't explain things clearly because they're too far removed. And the hype peddlers don't give you anything actionable. They just make you feel behind (or try to sell you on their AI community.)

Here, it's my mission to breakdown AI concepts, use-cases, and real world examples in a tactical way. 

I was previously Head of Growth at a YC-backed AI startup. I study and use these tools nonstop, and want to pull up others with me as I go. 

By learning how to apply AI to improve your life and work, you arbitrage the skill gap, and set yourself up for generational success. 

We're just getting started, but I'd love to have you aboard the rocket ship. - Ben

snippet.title: Lech Wargin
snippet.description:
Technik z pasji, entuzjasta AI z konieczności i wyboru.

Nazywam się Lech Wargin. Jestem dumnym absolwentem Technikum Łączności w Gdańsku. Moja droga zawodowa była kręta – od pracy na etacie, przez własne firmy, które nauczyły mnie pokory, aż po moment, w którym życie powiedziało 'sprawdzam'.

Przeszedłem udar, który odebrał mi dawną sprawność mowy. Kiedyś uwielbiałem opowiadać historie i zarażać ludzi entuzjazmem na żywo. Dziś robię to inaczej. Dzięki technologii (korzystam z speechtexter.com) odzyskałem głos w cyfrowym świecie.

Nie jestem teoretykiem. Jestem praktykiem, który się nie poddaje. Obecnie własnymi rękami remontuję stary dom i od roku zgłębiam tajniki agentów AI (n8n, GPT), budując narzędzia, które ułatwiają życie.

Na tym kanale pokazuję, że nowa technologia nie jest tylko dla młodych informatyków z korporacji. Jest dla każdego, kto chce przekraczać swoje bariery. Zapraszam do mojego świata.

Przeszedłem udar, który odebrał mi dawną sprawność mowy. Kiedyś uwielbiałem opowiadać historie i zarażać ludzi entuzjazmem na żywo. Dziś robię to inaczej. Dzięki technologii (korzystam z speechtexter.com) odzyskałem głos w cyfrowym świecie.

Nie jestem teoretykiem. Jestem praktykiem, który się nie poddaje. Obecnie własnymi rękami remontuję stary dom i od roku zgłębiam tajniki agentów AI (n8n, GPT), budując narzędzia, które ułatwiają życie.

Na tym kanale pokazuję, że nowa technologia nie jest tylko dla młodych informatyków z korporacji. Jest dla każdego, kto chce przekraczać swoje bariery. Zapraszam do mojego świata.

snippet.title: 追日Gucci-AI效率革命聯盟
snippet.description:

這些事，不必你親手做。我是追日 Gucci，這個頻道只做這一件事。

🔹 我幫誰
知識工作者、內容創作者、一人公司。共同點是工作裡有大量重複的部分，但你沒空停下來把它自動化。

🔹 我怎麼幫你
把單點的工具串成一條會自己跑的工作流。單點的工具幫你省一步，串起來的系統才真的接手工作。看完影片你做得出來：
・把你每週重複做的那件事，變成按一次就跑完的流程
・讓 AI 讀完一疊資料，直接產出你要的那份文件，不是給你一段摘要
・搭一組自己會跑的 AI Agent 排程，早上打開電腦，結果已經在那裡
・看得出 AI 哪一步會出錯、該怎麼檢查，交出去的東西你敢用
用到的工具：Claude Code、OpenClaw\Hermes、Hermes、Vibe Coding、n8n。不用寫程式也搆得到。

🔹 憑什麼相信我
你看到的每一支 30 分鐘長片，都是我自己搭的工作流做出來的。從選題、腳本、提詞簡報，到剪輯、字幕、字卡、B-roll、短版、上架文案和縮圖，我只負責出鏡、觀點和最後把關。每一段我都在頻道裡拆開講給你聽。

IT 產業 20 年，前世界三大記憶體大數據工程師，2019 年離職，現在是一人公司。2014 年開始經營自媒體，前十年寫美股投資，出過一本書，上過《Smart 智富》、《鏡週刊》和非凡新聞的專訪。儘管如此，我選擇放棄這十年累積的一切，2024 年起全面轉向 AI，並帶領付費社群《AI 效率革命聯盟》。

女兒剛滿 3 歲那年起，我帶著她和老婆旅居東南亞。不是度假，我照常工作，女兒照常上學。要用更多時間去換更多錢的事，我已經不願意做了。

📌 訂閱，挑一支跟你工作最像的影片看完；再從你每週都在重複做的一件事開始，判斷它值不值得自動化。

snippet.title: DevRev
snippet.description:
Computer is a precise, efficient, and safe AI platform for enterprise search, employee service/help desk, and customer support, including voice.

It unifies your systems and data into Native Shared Memory, a patented, AI-ready knowledge graph. Every answer and action is grounded in company context, while respecting permissions and safety guardrails.

In Enterprise-Bench, an open, vendor-neutral benchmark developed with Laude Institute, Computer delivered:
• 48% higher accuracy
• 4.4x fewer tokens
• Flat cost at 256x data growth vs. 29% growth

Real-world results:
• Bolt: 40% faster ticket resolution, 43% fewer live tickets, 25% higher retention
• BILL: 70% of tickets resolved without humans, up to $6M annual savings
• $1.1B org: 2,000+ hires onboarded without additional IT staff

DevRev is headquartered in Palo Alto, with eight global offices and $150M+ raised from investors including Khosla Ventures and Mayfield. Founded by Dheeraj Pandey and Manoj Agarwal.

snippet.title: monExpansion
snippet.description:
Entrepreneur·es 40+ : rattrape le train de l'IA, sans y passer tes journées.

Je m'appelle Julien Klein. Je dirige monExpansion, à Montréal. Quinze ans à diriger des équipes VFX chez Rodeo FX puis Scanline VFX pour Netflix (Game of Thrones, Star Wars). Aujourd'hui, j'installe l'IA chez des entrepreneurs qui ont autre chose à faire que regarder des tutos.

Ma conviction : plus tu as d'expérience, plus l'IA te sert.

Sur cette chaîne :
- Des cas d'usage, pas des tutos
- Des résultats réels : un site refait en une heure, un courrier trié avant le café, des vidéos montées par l'IA
- Ce que j'ai bâti pour ma propre vie : forme, devoirs des enfants, décisions du matin
- Le tri entre ce qui marche et ce qui fait du bruit

Comment je travaille : j'installe avec toi, dans tes outils, puis tu repars autonome.

Audit gratuit, 45 minutes : tidycal.com/julienklein/decouverte
monexpansion.com

snippet.title: Travis Marziani
snippet.description:
Want my personal help launching or scaling your own Amazon business? Click below 👇

I was sad and stuck in the corporate world, when I quit that to start an online dance clothing business with my mom. After years of growing the revenue but struggling to make enough profit to support myself I had to move back in with my parents. It was at this point I realized I want to create a business I was passionate about, and I took all the lessons learned and created my first +$100K/year product, and more importantly I loved my business, my life and I started enjoying the journey.

Since then I've taught this to +4,000 students and made +12.3M in sales.

I want to give you what I wish I would have known when I first started:  

1. Data-driven methods to find winning products. 

2. A proven A-Z launch blueprint and growth hacks. 

3. Talking to reals sellers and showing you both the wins and losses. 

Always easy, no experience needed. Thanks for joining!

snippet.title: Syntax
snippet.description:
Hosted by Wes Bos and Scott Tolinski since 2017, Syntax has published over 900 podcast episodes on full-stack web development, covering everything from HTML, CSS, JavaScript, server side languages, databases, deployment environments, and more.

In 2023 Syntax.fm joined forces with Level Up Tutorials adding 2000+ free video tutorials to our library.

Wes Bos is co-host of Syntax and a web development educator. Constantly learning, he creates web development courses focused on JavaScript, TypeScript, React, CSS, Node.js and whatever else comes his way.

Scott Tolinski is co-host of Syntax and the creator of Level Up Tutorials. In his free time Scott is a dedicated Bboy (breakdancer) & enjoys pushing himself athletically through dance, working out and snowboarding.

CJ joined the team to help make YouTube videos that dive deeper into topics covered on the podcast. He is a full stack software developer and the host of Coding Garden.

Syntax is brought to you by Sentry (https://sentry.io)

snippet.title: Parikshit Pruthi
snippet.description:
Most engineers use AI coding tools at 10% of what they can do. I teach the other 90%.

I spent 10 years as a senior engineer at Amazon and 3 years teaching DSA and system design at Scaler. 

Now I build production systems with Claude Code and Cursor, and I show engineering teams how to get senior-level output from these tools without shipping code that leaks data, burns tokens, and breaks the moment a real user touches it.

What you'll find here:

→ How to actually drive Claude Code and Cursor on a real codebase, not a toy demo
→ Context engineering and the prompting workflows that get senior-level results
→ Teardowns of where AI code leaks data, wastes tokens, and dies in production
→ The gap between a demo that works and something you can ship

If you write code for a living and you want AI to make you sharper instead of sloppier, subscribe.

Work with me / team workshops: https://calendly.com/parikshit-accelerate-ai/15min

snippet.title: Savanna Timofei
snippet.description:
AI and automation for small business owners, from someone who actually runs them.

I'm Savanna, I'm in my forties and I run several small businesses from my home office in the UK, and over the past year I've handed more and more of the day-to-day work over to AI so I can spend my time on the parts that grow them. I've built an assistant that checks my emails and to-do list every morning and tells me what the day holds, and a control centre that keeps all my businesses in one place.

On this channel I show you how I built each one, step by step, so you can set up something similar in your own business. If you know AI could help but you're not sure where to start, or you've tried ChatGPT and want it to do far more than write captions, this is for you. I'll be honest about what's saved me real time and what wasn't worth the bother, and now and then I'll share how I use AI outside of work too.

New videos every week, with the tools I use linked under each one.

snippet.title: reAPI
snippet.description:
reAPI is one API for every top AI model — image, video, music, chat, and code.
This channel is where those models get put to work.

Every leading generation model ships with its own SDK, its own quirks, and its
own idea of what a "prompt" is. We cut through that: what each model is
actually good at, what it really costs per output, and how to wire it into
something that ships.

On this channel:
• Model showdowns — identical prompt, every major video and image model, side by side
• Build-alongs — empty file to working generation endpoint, start to finish
• Release breakdowns — what a new model genuinely changes for developers
• Cost & latency teardowns — measured numbers, not launch-post claims

One endpoint. Automatic failover when a provider goes down. 99.96% uptime.
Zero request logging — your prompts and outputs are never stored.

Start building → https://reapi.ai
Docs → https://reapi.ai/docs

snippet.title: Thái Vân Linh Skills Bridge
snippet.description:
Linh Thai has over 24 years of experience in finance, marketing, and operations. Linh is passionate about helping people unlock their full potential by providing the tools and inspiration to help them help themselves.

Linh is the CEO of Skills Bridge, a training and development company dedicated to empowering business professionals. 

Linh is also a Senior Advisor at Openspace Ventures. Some of her prior roles include Head of Strategy and Operations at VinaCapital, one of the leading asset managers in Vietnam; and Director of Investments at DFJ VinaCapital, one of Vietnam’s first venture capital funds.  Linh is also fondly known as “Shark Linh”, for her role as an investor in the television show, Shark Tank Vietnam.

Linh graduated with honors from the University of Southern California and holds an MBA from The Wharton School. She grew up in Los Angeles, CA and has called Ho Chi Minh City home for the past 15 years.
